newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by weighted stocks.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by weighted stocks.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up on gains by some blue chip shares which, brokers said, helped the market to outweigh selling pressure from investors seeking to book profit.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 14.30 points or 0.93 percent at 1,546.75 on a turnover of 127.4 million taka. Of the 114 issues traded, 64 closed down, 46 ended up and four were unchanged.
Singer Bangladesh gained 52.24 taka to 12,653.33, Meghna Cement was up 33.86 to 805.79 and Padma Textile lost 4.63 to 398.10. -- Dhaka Newsroom 88-02-506363
